ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Annual Wellness Visit, Subsequent — Benjamin Franklin — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

text.paragraph: Subsequent annual wellness visit; no new complaints. [S]

Mr. Franklin returns for his subsequent annual wellness visit, five weeks after his six-month gout and kidney review. He completed the health risk assessment before the visit. He has had no gout flare since the knee flare in July and stopped colchicine in September with his urate at target. He voids comfortably since his prostate operation in the spring. He drinks wine with dinner most days and has cut down on large dinners. He walks 30 minutes most days. He has had no falls, emergency visits, or hospital stays in the past year apart from the planned operation. He takes his medicines from a weekly organizer and has added no over-the-counter medicines. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent. He has a written health care directive and has named a health care agent; a copy is in the chart. He wants full treatment for reversible illness, including surgery and hospital care. He would not want prolonged mechanical ventilation or resuscitation if he could not return to reading, writing, and conversation. He will review these wishes with his agent. [S]
